method: One controlled fault at a time, applied to a clean tree, gates run cheapest-first with early stop on the first failure. A mutation nothing catches has been run against the COMPLETE suite.

verdicts.ESCAPED: nothing caught it AND it changes what users see now - a real gap
verdicts.LATENT: nothing caught it and it changes nothing today, but it WOULD change results after a cache rebuild - the most dangerous shape, because the history stays green until long after the cause
verdicts.INERT: nothing caught it because it changes nothing observable at all - not a gate gap
verdicts.PASS: inverse test: a non-combat change correctly triggered no combat gate
verdicts.FAIL: inverse test: a non-combat change wrongly triggered a combat gate
